# Flygon Flow API reference

58 operations · Releases: `GET /api/devlog` on your Flow server (one per production deploy), also in the app under Settings › DevLog.

Every operation is an HTTP call under the base URL of your Flow server:

```sh
curl -sS "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/envs/$FLOW_ENV/cards" -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY"
```

Keys look like `flow_…` and carry a scope: `read` (list and get), `write` (create, update and move) or `admin` (keys, sharing and environments). The OpenAPI document is at `/api/v1/openapi.json`. Errors come back with an HTTP status plus a `code` and a `message`. Path parameters such as `{env}` are filled from the input. Any other input is sent as the query string for GET and DELETE, or as the JSON body otherwise.

## Environments

### `envs.list`

List environments

`GET /api/v1/envs` · scope `read` · MCP tool `envs_list`

Environments (workspaces) you own, newest first. Use an id from here as {env} in every other call. What others share with you is inside the environment you added it to: a chart named "Shared · <their environment>" (unless you moved its cards), with ids sh.<share>.<id>. Edits to it go back to its owner when the share allows them.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `limit` | integer |  | Page size (1-200, default 50). |
| `cursor` | string |  | nextCursor from the previous page. |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | object[] | yes |  |
| `items[].id` | string | yes |  |
| `items[].name` | string | yes |  |
| `items[].visibility` | enum | yes | One of `private`, `public`. |
| `items[].owner` | string |  |  |
| `items[].rev` | integer | yes |  |
| `items[].updatedAt` | string | null |  |  |
| `nextCursor` | string | null | yes |  |

**Example: Your environments**

```sh
curl -sS -X GET "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/envs" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY"
```

```json
{
  "items": [
    {
      "id": "default-workspace",
      "name": "Default workspace",
      "visibility": "private",
      "owner": "owner@example.test",
      "rev": 42,
      "updatedAt": "2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z"
    }
  ],
  "nextCursor": null
}
```

| `environment.visibility` | enum | yes | One of `private`, `public`. |
| `environment.owner` | string |  |  |
| `environment.rev` | integer | yes |  |
| `environment.updatedAt` | string | null |  |  |
| `environment.counts` | object |  |  |


```json
      "nodes": 7,
      "edges": 7,
      "projects": 3,
      "items": 12,
```

## Nodes

### `nodes.list`

List nodes

`GET /api/v1/envs/{env}/charts/{chart}/nodes` · scope `read` · MCP tool `nodes_list`

Cards on a chart (entities, people, areas, notes). Filter by `type`, or by `q` (name contains).

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `env` | string | yes | Environment id (see envs.list). |
| `chart` | string | yes | Chart id, or "active" for the chart open in the app. |
| `type` | enum |  | One of `entity`, `person`, `area`, `note`. |
| `q` | string |  |  |
| `limit` | integer |  | Page size (1-200, default 50). |
| `cursor` | string |  | nextCursor from the previous page. |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | object[] | yes |  |
| `items[].id` | string | yes |  |
| `items[].name` | string | yes |  |
| `items[].type` | enum | yes | One of `entity`, `person`, `area`, `note`. |
| `items[].x` | number | yes |  |
| `items[].y` | number | yes |  |
| `items[].w` | number |  |  |
| `items[].h` | number |  |  |
| `items[].notes` | string |  |  |
| `items[].image` | string |  | Person photo: an https URL or a data:image/(png\|jpeg\|webp);base64 URL. |
| `items[].email` | string |  | Person email, matching them to an account. |
| `items[].opidUser` | string |  | Read only: the OneProfileID account the person linked this card to, so it shows their account photo. Only that person can link it, from the app. Changing or removing the card's email unlinks it. |

### `nodes.create`

Create a node

`POST /api/v1/envs/{env}/charts/{chart}/nodes` · scope `write` · MCP tool `nodes_create`

Add a card to a chart. Without x/y it is placed at the origin, stepping 32px diagonally past occupied spots (as the app does). On a share's chart ("Shared · …") it is added to the share's owner when the share lets you add (pending: true while it waits for their approval); a share that does not is refused with 403 share_adds_off.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `env` | string | yes | Environment id (see envs.list). |
| `chart` | string | yes | Chart id, or "active" for the chart open in the app. |
| `type` | enum | yes | One of `entity`, `person`, `area`, `note`. |
| `name` | string | yes |  |
| `notes` | string |  |  |
| `w` | number |  |  |
| `h` | number |  |  |
| `image` | string |  | Person cards only: a photo as an https URL, or a data:image/(png\|jpeg\|webp);base64 URL up to 61440 characters. "" removes it. |
| `email` | string |  | Person cards only: their email, so the app can show the matching account photo. Never shared with share recipients. Changing or removing it unlinks the card from its OneProfileID account. "" removes it. |
| `x` | number |  |  |
| `y` | number |  |  |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rev` | integer | yes | Workspace revision after (or at) this call. |
| `node` | object | yes |  |
| `node.id` | string | yes |  |
| `node.name` | string | yes |  |
| `node.type` | enum | yes | One of `entity`, `person`, `area`, `note`. |
| `node.x` | number | yes |  |
| `node.y` | number | yes |  |
| `node.w` | number |  |  |
| `node.h` | number |  |  |
| `node.notes` | string |  |  |
| `node.image` | string |  | Person photo: an https URL or a data:image/(png\|jpeg\|webp);base64 URL. |
| `node.email` | string |  | Person email, matching them to an account. |
| `node.opidUser` | string |  | Read only: the OneProfileID account the person linked this card to, so it shows their account photo. Only that person can link it, from the app. Changing or removing the card's email unlinks it. |
| `pending` | boolean |  | Only when true: the record was added inside a share whose owner approves additions, and waits for them (docs/sharing.md). It shows as "Pending approval" until they approve or deny it. |

**Example: Add a person**

```sh
curl -sS -X POST "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/envs/default-workspace/charts/active/nodes" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"type":"person","name":"Cleo Park","x":320,"y":144}'
```

```json
{
  "rev": 43,
  "node": {
    "id": "cleo",
    "name": "Cleo Park",
    "type": "person",
    "x": 320,
    "y": 144,
    "notes": ""
  }
}
```

## Edges

### `edges.list`

List edges

`GET /api/v1/envs/{env}/charts/{chart}/edges` · scope `read` · MCP tool `edges_list`

Connections on a chart. Ownership edges carry a percent ("" when unspecified); group edges are grouping only.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `env` | string | yes | Environment id (see envs.list). |
| `chart` | string | yes | Chart id, or "active" for the chart open in the app. |
| `node` | string |  | Only edges touching this node id. |
| `limit` | integer |  | Page size (1-200, default 50). |
| `cursor` | string |  | nextCursor from the previous page. |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | object[] | yes |  |
| `items[].id` | string | yes |  |
| `items[].from` | string | yes |  |
| `items[].to` | string | yes |  |
| `items[].type` | enum | yes | One of `ownership`, `group`. |
| `items[].percent` | string | yes |  |
| `nextCursor` | string | null | yes |  |
| `rev` | integer | yes | Workspace revision after (or at) this call. |

**Example: Edges**

```sh
curl -sS -X GET "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/envs/default-workspace/charts/active/edges" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY"
```

```json
{
  "items": [
    {
      "id": "o1",
      "from": "cleo",
      "to": "quill",
      "type": "ownership",
      "percent": "50"
    }

}
```

### `edges.create`

Create an edge

`POST /api/v1/envs/{env}/charts/{chart}/edges` · scope `write` · MCP tool `edges_create`

Connect two cards on the same chart. A second edge between the same pair (same direction) is refused with 409. Joining two cards of the same share adds the connection to its owner, as nodes.create does.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `env` | string | yes | Environment id (see envs.list). |
| `chart` | string | yes | Chart id, or "active" for the chart open in the app. |
| `from` | string | yes | Node id. |
| `to` | string | yes | Node id. |
| `type` | enum |  | One of `ownership`, `group`. |
| `percent` | string | number |  | 0-100, or "" for unspecified. |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rev` | integer | yes | Workspace revision after (or at) this call. |
| `edge` | object | yes |  |
| `edge.id` | string | yes |  |
| `edge.from` | string | yes |  |
| `edge.to` | string | yes |  |
| `edge.type` | enum | yes | One of `ownership`, `group`. |
| `edge.percent` | string | yes |  |
| `pending` | boolean |  | Only when true: the record was added inside a share whose owner approves additions, and waits for them (docs/sharing.md). It shows as "Pending approval" until they approve or deny it. |

**Example: 50% ownership**

```sh
curl -sS -X POST "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/envs/default-workspace/charts/active/edges" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"from":"cleo","to":"quill","percent":"50"}'
```

```json
{
  "rev": 45,
  "edge": {
    "id": "o1",
    "from": "cleo",
    "to": "quill",
    "type": "ownership",
    "percent": "50"
  }
}
```

### `edges.update`

Update an edge

`PATCH /api/v1/envs/{env}/charts/{chart}/edges/{edge}` · scope `write` · MCP tool `edges_update`

Change a connection's ownership percent or its type, keeping the edge. Fields left out stay as they are; a group edge carries no percent. On a share's chart an edit share lets you change the percent, and the change goes back to its owner; the type stays the owner's.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `env` | string | yes | Environment id (see envs.list). |
| `chart` | string | yes | Chart id, or "active" for the chart open in the app. |
| `edge` | string | yes | Edge id. |
| `type` | enum |  | One of `ownership`, `group`. |
| `percent` | string | number |  | 0-100, or "" for unspecified. |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rev` | integer | yes | Workspace revision after (or at) this call. |
| `edge` | object | yes |  |
| `edge.id` | string | yes |  |
| `edge.from` | string | yes |  |
| `edge.to` | string | yes |  |
| `edge.type` | enum | yes | One of `ownership`, `group`. |
| `edge.percent` | string | yes |  |

**Example: Full ownership**

```sh
curl -sS -X PATCH "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/envs/default-workspace/charts/active/edges/o1" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"percent":"100"}'
```

```json
{
  "rev": 46,
  "edge": {
    "id": "o1",
    "from": "cleo",
    "to": "quill",
    "type": "ownership",
    "percent": "100"
  }
}
```

### `edges.delete`

Delete an edge

`DELETE /api/v1/envs/{env}/charts/{chart}/edges/{edge}` · scope `write` · MCP tool `edges_delete`

Remove one connection. The cards it joined stay. Earlier revisions are kept in the workspace history.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `env` | string | yes | Environment id (see envs.list). |
| `chart` | string | yes | Chart id, or "active" for the chart open in the app. |
| `edge` | string | yes | Edge id. |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rev` | integer | yes | Workspace revision after (or at) this call. |
| `deleted` | string | yes |  |

**Example: Delete**

```sh
curl -sS -X DELETE "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/envs/default-workspace/charts/active/edges/o1" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY"
```

```json
{
  "rev": 46,
  "deleted": "o1"
}
```

### `projects.create`

Create a project

`POST /api/v1/envs/{env}/projects` · scope `write` · MCP tool `projects_create`

Add a project. Names are unique (case-insensitive); a duplicate gets 409. Without a colour the next palette colour is used. Under a shared entity, or with share, it is added to that share's owner when the share lets you add (pending: true while it waits for their approval).

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `env` | string | yes | Environment id (see envs.list). |
| `name` | string | yes |  |
| `color` | string |  | Hex colour, e.g. #7cb980. |
| `entity` | string |  | The chart entity or area it sits under: node id or name; "" for none. |
| `repos` | string[] |  | Code repositories that belong to the project: a name ("flow"), owner/name ("acme/flow") or a git remote URL. The 3D office shows a teammate's live agent working in one of them to everyone who can see this project. Replaces the list; [] clears it. |
| `share` | string |  | Add it to the owner of a share placed in this environment (the <share> in its sh.<share>.<id> ids), when that share lets you add. Without it, a record that refers to a share's records (a card in a shared project, say) goes to that share's owner anyway. |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rev` | integer | yes | Workspace revision after (or at) this call. |
| `project` | object | yes |  |
| `project.id` | string | yes |  |
| `project.name` | string | yes |  |
| `project.color` | string | yes |  |
| `project.entity` | string | yes |  |
| `project.repos` | string[] |  | Code repositories that belong to the project (absent when none). |
| `pending` | boolean |  | Only when true: the record was added inside a share whose owner approves additions, and waits for them (docs/sharing.md). It shows as "Pending approval" until they approve or deny it. |

**Example: Under Kestrel Group**

```sh
curl -sS -X POST "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/envs/default-workspace/projects" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"name":"Lantern","color":"#7cb980","entity":"Kestrel Group"}'
```

```json
{
  "rev": 47,
  "project": {
    "id": "p1",
    "name": "Lantern",
    "color": "#7cb980",
    "entity": "flygon"
  }
}
```

## DevOps cards

### `cards.list`

List DevOps cards

`GET /api/v1/envs/{env}/cards` · scope `read` · MCP tool `cards_list`

Board cards in board order. Filters: column, project (id, name or "none"), label (id or name), assignee (person id or name, or "none" for unassigned), agent (AgentFlow agent: cards delegated to it), q ("#12" or title text), hideDone, snoozed (true: only cards snoozed now; false: only awake ones; left out: both). notProject, notLabel, notAssignee, notAgent and notEntity leave out cards that match. Include and exclude combine.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `env` | string | yes | Environment id (see envs.list). |
| `column` | string |  | Board column: requests (Requests / Sprinted), doing (Doing), blocked (Blocked), uat (UAT), done (Done), must (Backlog: Must Have), nice (Backlog: Nice to Have). One of `requests`, `doing`, `blocked`, `uat`, `done`, `must`, `nice`. |
| `project` | string |  | Project id or name, or "none". |
| `label` | string |  | Label id or name. |
| `assignee` | string |  | Person node id or name, or a share member (@email or email), or "none" for unassigned. |
| `agent` | string |  | AgentFlow agent id or name: cards delegated to it. |
| `notProject` | string |  | Project id or name, or "none": leave these cards out. |
| `notLabel` | string |  | Label id or name: leave cards with this label out. |
| `notAssignee` | string |  | Person node id or name, or a share member (@email or email), or "none": leave unassigned cards out. |
| `notAgent` | string |  | AgentFlow agent id or name: leave out cards delegated to it. |
| `notEntity` | string |  | Entity or area id or name: leave out cards in the projects under it. |
| `q` | string |  |  |
| `hideDone` | boolean |  |  |
| `snoozed` | boolean |  | true: only cards snoozed now; false: leave them out. |
| `limit` | integer |  | Page size (1-200, default 50). |
| `cursor` | string |  | nextCursor from the previous page. |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | object[] | yes |  |
| `items[].id` | string | yes |  |
| `items[].number` | integer | yes |  |
| `items[].title` | string | yes |  |
| `items[].description` | string |  |  |
| `items[].column` | string | yes |  |
| `items[].project` | string |  |  |
| `items[].labels` | string[] | yes |  |
| `items[].points` | number | null |  |  |
| `items[].actual` | number | null |  | Points the card actually took, recorded after the work (for example from the agents' token use). Separate from points, the up-front estimate. |
| `items[].due` | string |  |  |
| `items[].snoozedUntil` | string | null |  | When the snooze ends (ISO time). Until then the board hides the card for everyone (a column header can show its snoozed cards); afterwards it is a normal card again. null when not snoozed. |
| `items[].assignees` | object[] | yes |  |
| `items[].checklist` | object[] | yes |  |
| `items[].links` | object[] | yes |  |
| `items[].item` | string |  |  |
| `items[].created` | string |  |  |
| `items[].updated` | string |  |  |
| `items[].moved` | string |  |  |
| `items[].agents` | string[] |  | AgentFlow agents the card is delegated to (ids). |
| `nextCursor` | string | null | yes |  |
| `rev` | integer | yes | Workspace revision after (or at) this call. |

**Example: Open cards for a project**

```sh
curl -sS -X GET "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/envs/default-workspace/cards?project=Lantern&hideDone=true" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY"
```

```json
{
  "items": [
    {
      "id": "k1",
      "number": 12,
      "title": "Build sign-up form",
      "description": "",
      "column": "requests",
      "project": "p1",
      "labels": [
        "l-high"
      ],
      "points": 3,
      "actual": null,
      "due": "2026-11-15",
      "assignees": [
        {
          "node": "cleo",
          "role": "developer"
        }
      ],
      "checklist": [
        {
          "id": "x1",
          "text": "Email field",
          "done": false
        }
      ],
      "links": [],
      "item": "i1",
      "created": "2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z",
      "updated": "2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z",
      "moved": "2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z",
      "snoozedUntil": null,
      "agents": [
        "a1"
      ]
    }
  ],
  "nextCursor": null,
  "rev": 42
}
```

### `cards.create`

Create a DevOps card

`POST /api/v1/envs/{env}/cards` · scope `write` · MCP tool `cards_create`

Add a card (it gets the next #number). Lands in Requests / Sprinted unless `column` says otherwise. References (project, labels, assignees, item) are ids or names; unknown ones are refused with 400. In a shared project, or with share, it is added to that share's owner when the share lets you add, and number is the owner's (pending: true while it waits for their approval: number is provisional until the owner numbers it); a share that does not is refused with 403 share_adds_off. A shared card takes only the share's people (their linked person cards or share members); a person card of your own is refused with 400 person_not_in_share.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `env` | string | yes | Environment id (see envs.list). |
| `column` | string |  | Board column: requests (Requests / Sprinted), doing (Doing), blocked (Blocked), uat (UAT), done (Done), must (Backlog: Must Have), nice (Backlog: Nice to Have). One of `requests`, `doing`, `blocked`, `uat`, `done`, `must`, `nice`. |
| `title` | string | yes |  |
| `description` | string |  |  |
| `project` | string |  | Project id or name; "" for none. |
| `labels` | string[] |  |  |
| `points` | number | null |  |  |
| `actual` | number | null |  | Points the card actually took, recorded after the work (for example from the agents' token use). Separate from points, the up-front estimate. |
| `due` | string |  | YYYY-MM-DD, or "" for none. |
| `snoozedUntil` | string | null |  | Snooze the card until this time: an ISO time such as 2026-11-23T16:00:00Z (include Z or a time zone offset). "" or null wakes it. A time already past wakes it too. |
| `assignees` | object[] |  |  |
| `assignees[].node` | string | yes | A person on a chart (node id or name), or someone the card is shared with (@email, email or name). |
| `assignees[].role` | enum |  | One of `developer`, `tester`, `requester`. |
| `checklist` | object[] |  |  |
| `checklist[].id` | string |  |  |
| `checklist[].text` | string | yes |  |
| `checklist[].done` | boolean |  |  |
| `links` | object[] |  |  |
| `links[].id` | string |  |  |
| `links[].kind` | enum |  | One of `pr`, `commit`, `url`. |
| `links[].url` | string | yes |  |
| `item` | string |  | Timeline item id or title; "" for none. |
| `agents` | string[] |  | Delegate the card to these agents (replaces the list; [] for none). It joins each one's work queue (agents.work). |
| `share` | string |  | Add it to the owner of a share placed in this environment (the <share> in its sh.<share>.<id> ids), when that share lets you add. Without it, a record that refers to a share's records (a card in a shared project, say) goes to that share's owner anyway. |

**Output**

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rev` | integer | yes | Workspace revision after (or at) this call. |

| `card.project` | string |  |  |
| `card.labels` | string[] | yes |  |

| `card.due` | string |  |  |
| `card.snoozedUntil` | string | null |  | When the snooze ends (ISO time). Until then the board hides the card for everyone (a column header can show its snoozed cards); afterwards it is a normal card again. null when not snoozed. |
| `card.assignees` | object[] | yes |  |
| `card.checklist` | object[] | yes |  |
| `card.links` | object[] | yes |  |
| `card.item` | string |  |  |
| `card.created` | string |  |  |
| `card.updated` | string |  |  |
| `card.moved` | string |  |  |
| `card.agents` | string[] |  | AgentFlow agents the card is delegated to (ids). |
| `pending` | boolean |  | Only when true: the record was added inside a share whose owner approves additions, and waits for them (docs/sharing.md). It shows as "Pending approval" until they approve or deny it. |

### `cards.update`

Update a DevOps card

`PATCH /api/v1/envs/{env}/cards/{card}` · scope `write` · MCP tool `cards_update`

Change a card's fields. Lists you send (labels, assignees, checklist, links) replace the old ones. snoozedUntil snoozes the card until an ISO time ("" or null wakes it). The column only changes through cards.move, which applies the board's gates. A description you send replaces the old one: to add to it, read the card and send ifUpdated (its `updated`), so a change someone made meanwhile is refused with 409 card_changed instead of lost.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `env` | string | yes | Environment id (see envs.list). |
| `card` | string | integer | yes | Card number or id. |
| `title` | string |  |  |
| `description` | string |  |  |
| `project` | string |  | Project id or name; "" for none. |
| `labels` | string[] |  |  |
| `points` | number | null |  |  |
| `actual` | number | null |  | Points the card actually took, recorded after the work (for example from the agents' token use). Separate from points, the up-front estimate. |
| `due` | string |  | YYYY-MM-DD, or "" for none. |
| `snoozedUntil` | string | null |  | Snooze the card until this time: an ISO time such as 2026-11-23T16:00:00Z (include Z or a time zone offset). "" or null wakes it. A time already past wakes it too. |
| `assignees` | object[] |  |  |
| `assignees[].node` | string | yes | A person on a chart (node id or name), or someone the card is shared with (@email, email or name). |
| `assignees[].role` | enum |  | One of `developer`, `tester`, `requester`. |
| `checklist` | object[] |  |  |
| `checklist[].id` | string |  |  |
| `checklist[].text` | string | yes |  |
| `checklist[].done` | boolean |  |  |
| `links` | object[] |  |  |
| `links[].id` | string |  |  |
| `links[].kind` | enum |  | One of `pr`, `commit`, `url`. |
| `links[].url` | string | yes |  |
| `item` | string |  | Timeline item id or title; "" for none. |
| `agents` | string[] |  | Delegate the card to these agents (replaces the list; [] for none). It joins each one's work queue (agents.work). |
| `ifUpdated` | string |  | The card's `updated` as you read it (cards.get). If the card changed since, nothing is written: 409 card_changed, with the current card in details.card. Read it again and reapply your change. |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rev` | integer | yes | Workspace revision after (or at) this call. |
| `card` | object | yes |  |
| `card.id` | string | yes |  |
| `card.number` | integer | yes |  |
| `card.title` | string | yes |  |
| `card.description` | string |  |  |
| `card.column` | string | yes |  |
| `card.project` | string |  |  |
| `card.labels` | string[] | yes |  |
| `card.points` | number | null |  |  |
| `card.actual` | number | null |  | Points the card actually took, recorded after the work (for example from the agents' token use). Separate from points, the up-front estimate. |
| `card.due` | string |  |  |
| `card.snoozedUntil` | string | null |  | When the snooze ends (ISO time). Until then the board hides the card for everyone (a column header can show its snoozed cards); afterwards it is a normal card again. null when not snoozed. |
| `card.assignees` | object[] | yes |  |
| `card.checklist` | object[] | yes |  |
| `card.links` | object[] | yes |  |
| `card.item` | string |  |  |
| `card.created` | string |  |  |
| `card.updated` | string |  |  |
| `card.moved` | string |  |  |
| `card.agents` | string[] |  | AgentFlow agents the card is delegated to (ids). |

### `cards.move`

Move a DevOps card

`POST /api/v1/envs/{env}/cards/{card}/move` · scope `write` · MCP tool `cards_move`

Move a card to a column (and position: `index` among that column's other cards; end if left out). The board's gates apply: into Done needs `confirm: true`, or `approve: true` from UAT (the Approve button); out of Done needs `confirm: true`; into Doing without a developer needs `developer` (a person, who is assigned) or `confirm: true` to leave it unassigned. A refused gate is 409 with code confirm_done, confirm_reopen or pick_developer. ifUpdated (the card's `updated` as you read it) refuses the move with 409 card_changed if the card changed since.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `env` | string | yes | Environment id (see envs.list). |
| `card` | string | integer | yes | Card number or id. |
| `column` | string | yes | Board column: requests (Requests / Sprinted), doing (Doing), blocked (Blocked), uat (UAT), done (Done), must (Backlog: Must Have), nice (Backlog: Nice to Have). One of `requests`, `doing`, `blocked`, `uat`, `done`, `must`, `nice`. |
| `index` | integer |  |  |
| `confirm` | boolean |  |  |
| `approve` | boolean |  |  |
| `developer` | string |  | Person node id or name, or someone the card is shared with (@email or email). |
| `ifUpdated` | string |  | The card's `updated` as you read it (cards.get). If the card changed since, nothing is written: 409 card_changed, with the current card in details.card. Read it again and reapply your change. |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rev` | integer | yes | Workspace revision after (or at) this call. |
| `card` | object | yes |  |
| `card.id` | string | yes |  |
| `card.number` | integer | yes |  |
| `card.title` | string | yes |  |
| `card.description` | string |  |  |
| `card.column` | string | yes |  |
| `card.project` | string |  |  |
| `card.labels` | string[] | yes |  |
| `card.points` | number | null |  |  |
| `card.actual` | number | null |  | Points the card actually took, recorded after the work (for example from the agents' token use). Separate from points, the up-front estimate. |
| `card.due` | string |  |  |
| `card.snoozedUntil` | string | null |  | When the snooze ends (ISO time). Until then the board hides the card for everyone (a column header can show its snoozed cards); afterwards it is a normal card again. null when not snoozed. |
| `card.assignees` | object[] | yes |  |
| `card.checklist` | object[] | yes |  |
| `card.links` | object[] | yes |  |
| `card.item` | string |  |  |
| `card.created` | string |  |  |
| `card.updated` | string |  |  |
| `card.moved` | string |  |  |
| `card.agents` | string[] |  | AgentFlow agents the card is delegated to (ids). |

### `cards.deleted`

List recently deleted cards

`GET /api/v1/envs/{env}/deleted-cards` · scope `read` · MCP tool `cards_deleted`

Cards removed from the board in the last 180 days, newest first, whatever removed them: deleting on the board, undo, a snapshot restore or other whole-workspace save, or the API and MCP. Each entry holds the whole card as it was, who removed it (deletedBy, via and, for an API key or MCP client, actor: the key's name), when, and the last revision it was in (fromRev). They outlive the revision history. Bring one back with cards.restore. Filters: q ("#12" or title text); pending: true leaves out the ones already restored.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `env` | string | yes | Environment id (see envs.list). |
| `q` | string |  |  |
| `pending` | boolean |  |  |
| `limit` | integer |  | Page size (1-200, default 50). |
| `cursor` | string |  | nextCursor from the previous page. |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | object[] | yes |  |
| `items[].id` | string | yes | Entry id, for cards.restore. |
| `items[].env` | string | yes |  |
| `items[].cardId` | string | yes |  |
| `items[].number` | integer | null | yes |  |
| `items[].title` | string | yes |  |
| `items[].card` | object | yes | The card as it was when it was removed. |
| `items[].deletedAt` | string | yes |  |
| `items[].deletedBy` | string | yes | Email of the account that saved the change. |
| `items[].via` | enum | yes | board (deleted on the board), undo (undo or redo), snapshot (a snapshot restore or other whole-workspace save from a browser), save (a save from an older browser tab), api, mcp, relay. One of `board`, `undo`, `snapshot`, `save`, `api`, `mcp`, `relay`. |
| `items[].actor` | string | yes | The API key's name, when an API key or MCP client removed it. |
| `items[].fromRev` | integer | yes | The last revision the card was in. |
| `items[].rev` | integer | yes | The revision that removed it. |
| `items[].restoredAt` | string | null | yes |  |
| `items[].restoredBy` | string |  |  |
| `items[].restoredNumber` | integer | null |  | The number it was restored as. |
| `nextCursor` | string | null | yes |  |
| `rev` | integer | yes | Workspace revision after (or at) this call. |

### `cards.restore`

Restore a deleted card

`POST /api/v1/envs/{env}/deleted-cards/{entry}/restore` · scope `write` · MCP tool `cards_restore`

Put a deleted card back on the board: same id, column, fields, checklist and links, and its agent links where the agents still exist (labels, projects or people since removed are dropped). It keeps its number if no other card has taken it; otherwise it gets the next number, renumbered is true and message says so. entry is an id from cards.deleted, or a card number ("#12") or card id for its latest deletion. A card that is already back is refused with 409 already_restored.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `env` | string | yes | Environment id (see envs.list). |
| `entry` | string | yes | Entry id from cards.deleted, or a card number ("#12") or card id. |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rev` | integer | yes | Workspace revision after (or at) this call. |
| `card` | object | yes |  |
| `card.id` | string | yes |  |
| `card.number` | integer | yes |  |
| `card.title` | string | yes |  |
| `card.description` | string |  |  |
| `card.column` | string | yes |  |
| `card.project` | string |  |  |
| `card.labels` | string[] | yes |  |
| `card.points` | number | null |  |  |
| `card.actual` | number | null |  | Points the card actually took, recorded after the work (for example from the agents' token use). Separate from points, the up-front estimate. |
| `card.due` | string |  |  |
| `card.snoozedUntil` | string | null |  | When the snooze ends (ISO time). Until then the board hides the card for everyone (a column header can show its snoozed cards); afterwards it is a normal card again. null when not snoozed. |
| `card.assignees` | object[] | yes |  |
| `card.checklist` | object[] | yes |  |
| `card.links` | object[] | yes |  |
| `card.item` | string |  |  |
| `card.created` | string |  |  |
| `card.updated` | string |  |  |
| `card.moved` | string |  |  |
| `card.agents` | string[] |  | AgentFlow agents the card is delegated to (ids). |
| `renumbered` | boolean | yes |  |
| `previousNumber` | integer | null | yes | The number it had before, when renumbered. |
| `message` | string | yes |  |

**Example: Restore #12**

```sh
curl -sS -X POST "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/envs/default-workspace/deleted-cards/%2312/restore" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY"
```

```json
{
  "rev": 63,
  "card": {
    "id": "k1",
    "number": 12,
    "title": "Build sign-up form",
```

### `agents.work`

Get an agent's work queue

`GET /api/v1/envs/{env}/agents/{agent}/work` · scope `read` · MCP tool `agents_work`

What a runner needs to work as this agent: its `brief` and its queue, the open DevOps cards delegated to it (cards.update agents, or the card's Delegated to picker). A card last changed by someone outside the environment (through an edit share) is left out until the owner changes it again. A snoozed card (snoozedUntil in the future) is left out too, still delegated, and comes back on its own when the snooze ends; includeSnoozed: true keeps snoozed cards in. Order: doing, requests, blocked, uat, must, nice (work in progress first; Blocked and UAT wait on others), then soonest due date, then #number. `columns` narrows the queue, e.g. ["doing","requests"] for cards it can act on now. Report back with cards.update (checklist, links) and cards.move.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `env` | string | yes | Environment id (see envs.list). |
| `agent` | string | yes | Agent id or name. |
| `columns` | string[] |  | Only these columns (comma-separated in a query string). |
| `includeSnoozed` | boolean |  | true: keep cards that are snoozed now (left out by default). |
| `limit` | integer |  | Page size (1-200, default 50). |
| `cursor` | string |  | nextCursor from the previous page. |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rev` | integer | yes | Workspace revision after (or at) this call. |
| `agent` | object | yes |  |
| `agent.id` | string | yes |  |
| `agent.name` | string | yes |  |
| `agent.kind` | enum | yes | One of `agent`, `human`, `team`, `automation`. |
| `agent.title` | string |  |  |
| `agent.status` | enum | yes | One of `draft`, `active`, `paused`, `retired`. |
| `agent.live` | boolean | yes |  |
| `agent.reportsTo` | string | yes |  |
| `agent.supervisor` | string | yes |  |
| `agent.purpose` | string |  |  |
| `agent.instructions` | string |  |  |
| `agent.runtime` | string |  |  |
| `agent.models` | string[] | yes |  |
| `agent.model` | string | yes |  |
| `agent.auto` | boolean | yes |  |
| `agent.schedule` | string |  | When it runs: plain text or cron; "" for none. |
| `agent.job` | object |  |  |
| `agent.inputs` | string[] | yes |  |
| `agent.outputs` | string[] | yes |  |
| `agent.tools` | string[] | yes |  |
| `agent.projects` | string[] | yes |  |
| `agent.cards` | string[] | yes |  |
| `agent.items` | string[] | yes |  |
| `agent.created` | string |  |  |
| `agent.updated` | string |  |  |
| `agent.x` | number |  |  |
| `agent.y` | number |  |  |
| `brief` | string | yes |  |
| `items` | object[] | yes |  |
| `items[].id` | string | yes |  |
| `items[].number` | integer | yes |  |
| `items[].title` | string | yes |  |
| `items[].description` | string |  |  |

| `items[].assignees` | object[] | yes |  |

### `agents.create`

Create an AgentFlow agent

`POST /api/v1/envs/{env}/agents` · scope `write` · MCP tool `agents_create`

Add an agent to the AgentFlow org chart. References (reportsTo, supervisor, projects, cards, items) are ids or names; unknown ones are refused with 400, and a reporting loop with reports_loop.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `env` | string | yes | Environment id (see envs.list). |
| `name` | string | yes |  |
| `kind` | enum |  | agent (AI agent), human, team, or automation (a scripted job without AI that runs on its own schedule outside Flow: no models, never live). One of `agent`, `human`, `team`, `automation`. |
| `title` | string |  | Role, e.g. Research. |
| `status` | enum |  | One of `draft`, `active`, `paused`, `retired`. |
| `live` | boolean |  | The switch runners obey: false (the default) and runners leave the agent alone; true and the runner named in runtime works its queue. |
| `reportsTo` | string |  | The agent it reports to: id or name; "" for top level. |
| `supervisor` | string |  | A person on a chart who oversees it: node id or name; "" for none. |
| `purpose` | string |  |  |
| `instructions` | string |  | System prompt or runbook. |
| `runtime` | string |  | Where it runs: a runner name from runners.list, e.g. a home server. |
| `models` | string[] |  | Model ids the runner reported (runners.list), in order: the primary first, then fallbacks it tries when one fails (or, with auto, the pool it picks from). Also sets model to the first. Wins over model when both are sent. |
| `model` | string |  | One model id, e.g. claudeAgent:claude-sonnet-5-5: the same as sending models with just it ("" for none). Always reads back as the first of models. |
| `auto` | boolean |  | false (the default): the runner starts on the first of models and falls back in order. true: models is a pool and the runner picks one per card. |
| `schedule` | string |  | When it runs, in plain words or cron, e.g. "Weekdays 09:00" (a note carried in the brief for an AI agent; the reference runner does not start work from it); "" for none. |
| `job` | union |  | The runner job it was promoted from: {runner, id} (see runners.report jobs); null or "" for none. |
| `inputs` | string[] |  | What it takes in. |
| `outputs` | string[] |  | What it produces. |
| `tools` | string[] |  | What it may use. |
| `projects` | string[] |  |  |
| `cards` | string | integer[] |  |  |
| `items` | string[] |  |  |
| `x` | number |  | Canvas position (with y). Leave out to place it under its manager. |
| `y` | number |  |  |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rev` | integer | yes | Workspace revision after (or at) this call. |
| `agent` | object | yes |  |
| `agent.id` | string | yes |  |
| `agent.name` | string | yes |  |
| `agent.kind` | enum | yes | One of `agent`, `human`, `team`, `automation`. |
| `agent.title` | string |  |  |
| `agent.status` | enum | yes | One of `draft`, `active`, `paused`, `retired`. |
| `agent.live` | boolean | yes |  |
| `agent.reportsTo` | string | yes |  |
| `agent.supervisor` | string | yes |  |
| `agent.purpose` | string |  |  |
| `agent.instructions` | string |  |  |
| `agent.runtime` | string |  |  |
| `agent.models` | string[] | yes |  |
| `agent.model` | string | yes |  |
| `agent.auto` | boolean | yes |  |
| `agent.schedule` | string |  | When it runs: plain text or cron; "" for none. |
| `agent.job` | object |  |  |
| `agent.inputs` | string[] | yes |  |
| `agent.outputs` | string[] | yes |  |
| `agent.tools` | string[] | yes |  |
| `agent.projects` | string[] | yes |  |
| `agent.cards` | string[] | yes |  |
| `agent.items` | string[] | yes |  |

### `agents.update`

Update an AgentFlow agent

`PATCH /api/v1/envs/{env}/agents/{agent}` · scope `write` · MCP tool `agents_update`

Change an agent's fields. Lists you send (inputs, outputs, tools, projects, cards, items) replace the old ones. Moving it under one of its own reports is refused with reports_loop.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `env` | string | yes | Environment id (see envs.list). |
| `agent` | string | yes | Agent id or name. |
| `name` | string |  |  |
| `kind` | enum |  | agent (AI agent), human, team, or automation (a scripted job without AI that runs on its own schedule outside Flow: no models, never live). One of `agent`, `human`, `team`, `automation`. |
| `title` | string |  | Role, e.g. Research. |
| `status` | enum |  | One of `draft`, `active`, `paused`, `retired`. |
| `live` | boolean |  | The switch runners obey: false (the default) and runners leave the agent alone; true and the runner named in runtime works its queue. |
| `reportsTo` | string |  | The agent it reports to: id or name; "" for top level. |
| `supervisor` | string |  | A person on a chart who oversees it: node id or name; "" for none. |
| `purpose` | string |  |  |
| `instructions` | string |  | System prompt or runbook. |
| `runtime` | string |  | Where it runs: a runner name from runners.list, e.g. a home server. |
| `models` | string[] |  | Model ids the runner reported (runners.list), in order: the primary first, then fallbacks it tries when one fails (or, with auto, the pool it picks from). Also sets model to the first. Wins over model when both are sent. |
| `model` | string |  | One model id, e.g. claudeAgent:claude-sonnet-5-5: the same as sending models with just it ("" for none). Always reads back as the first of models. |
| `auto` | boolean |  | false (the default): the runner starts on the first of models and falls back in order. true: models is a pool and the runner picks one per card. |
| `schedule` | string |  | When it runs, in plain words or cron, e.g. "Weekdays 09:00" (a note carried in the brief for an AI agent; the reference runner does not start work from it); "" for none. |
| `job` | union |  | The runner job it was promoted from: {runner, id} (see runners.report jobs); null or "" for none. |
| `inputs` | string[] |  | What it takes in. |
| `outputs` | string[] |  | What it produces. |
| `tools` | string[] |  | What it may use. |
| `projects` | string[] |  |  |
| `cards` | string | integer[] |  |  |
| `items` | string[] |  |  |
| `x` | number |  | Canvas position (with y). Leave out to place it under its manager. |
| `y` | number |  |  |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rev` | integer | yes | Workspace revision after (or at) this call. |
| `agent` | object | yes |  |
| `agent.id` | string | yes |  |
| `agent.name` | string | yes |  |
| `agent.kind` | enum | yes | One of `agent`, `human`, `team`, `automation`. |
| `agent.title` | string |  |  |
| `agent.status` | enum | yes | One of `draft`, `active`, `paused`, `retired`. |
| `agent.live` | boolean | yes |  |
| `agent.reportsTo` | string | yes |  |
| `agent.supervisor` | string | yes |  |
| `agent.purpose` | string |  |  |
| `agent.instructions` | string |  |  |
| `agent.runtime` | string |  |  |
| `agent.models` | string[] | yes |  |
| `agent.model` | string | yes |  |
| `agent.auto` | boolean | yes |  |
| `agent.schedule` | string |  | When it runs: plain text or cron; "" for none. |
| `agent.job` | object |  |  |
| `agent.inputs` | string[] | yes |  |
| `agent.outputs` | string[] | yes |  |
| `agent.tools` | string[] | yes |  |
| `agent.projects` | string[] | yes |  |
| `agent.cards` | string[] | yes |  |

### `runners.report`

Report a runner and its models

`POST /api/v1/envs/{env}/runners/{runner}` · scope `write` · MCP tool `runners_report`

A runner says what it can run, and optionally which scheduled jobs it found (systemd timers, cron, hosted crons...). The model list replaces the old one when sent (leave models out to keep the stored ones, e.g. when a runner reports the jobs of another machine it reaches over SSH), and so does jobs (leave it out to keep the stored jobs; [] clears them). Nothing is saved when nothing changed, so a runner may report on every pass: a report that only moves lastRun or nextRun is not saved either, unless the jobs were last saved 6 hours ago or more (jobsReported); a changed lastStatus, job or field always is. Agents name the runner in runtime and pick model ids; jobs show in the AgentFlow Scheduled tray, where they can be promoted into the org. A job can carry its full schedule: its timezone, every trigger with its raw expression, where it was read (origin, and the repo file), drift from the live schedule on the platform, and a note on conditions its script applies. Give each model a provider to group it by, and billing: included (a subscription or free) or metered (paid per use), which runners prefer included models by when picking automatically. Up to 20 runners, 1500 models and 500 jobs each.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `env` | string | yes | Environment id (see envs.list). |
| `runner` | string | yes | Runner name, e.g. Home server. |
| `models` | object[] |  | The models this runner can run (replaces the stored list; leave out to keep it). |
| `models[].id` | string | yes |  |
| `models[].label` | string |  |  |
| `models[].provider` | string |  | Display group, e.g. Claude or OpenCode. |
| `models[].billing` | enum |  | included (a subscription or free) or metered (paid per use). One of `included`, `metered`. |
| `jobs` | object[] |  | Scheduled jobs on this runner (replaces the stored list; leave out to keep it, [] to clear). |
| `jobs[].id` | string | yes | Stable per runner, e.g. systemd:backup.timer or vercel:my-app:/api/cron/sync. |
| `jobs[].name` | string |  | Defaults to the id. |
| `jobs[].source` | string |  | Where it is scheduled: systemd, cron, t3, vercel, railway, aside, windows, claude, codex, github or other (any text; defaults to other). |
| `jobs[].group` | string |  | Display group, e.g. "Home server" or "Vercel · my-app". |
| `jobs[].schedule` | string |  | When, in words, e.g. "Daily 22:30" or "Every 5 min". |
| `jobs[].cron` | string |  | The cron expression, when there is one. |
| `jobs[].timezone` | string |  | The zone its times are in: an IANA name such as America/Phoenix, "UTC", or "local" (the runner's own; see timezone on the runner). |
| `jobs[].triggers` | object[] |  | Every rule it fires on, e.g. each OnCalendar line of a systemd timer or each trigger of a Windows task. |
| `jobs[].origin` | enum |  | Where the schedule was read: repo (a config file in a repo; see file), platform (the hosting platform's API) or machine (the machine's own scheduler). One of `repo`, `platform`, `machine`. |
| `jobs[].file` | string |  | The repo-relative path of the config it came from, e.g. services/worker/railway.json. |
| `jobs[].drift` | string |  | How the platform's live schedule differs from the repo file, when it does. |
| `jobs[].note` | string |  | Conditions the job's script applies itself, e.g. "Exits early when nothing changed". |
| `jobs[].command` | string |  | A short summary of what it runs. |
| `jobs[].ai` | boolean |  | It starts an AI agent (promoted as an AI agent rather than an automation). |
| `jobs[].enabled` | boolean |  |  |
| `jobs[].lastRun` | string |  | ISO time of the last run. |
| `jobs[].lastStatus` | enum |  | One of `ok`, `failed`, `running`, `unknown`. |
| `jobs[].nextRun` | string |  | ISO time of the next run. |
| `timezone` | string |  | The runner machine's time zone (an IANA name), which jobs with timezone "local" are in. Left out, the stored one stays. |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rev` | integer | yes | Workspace revision after (or at) this call. |
| `runner` | object | yes |  |
| `runner.name` | string | yes |  |
| `runner.models` | object[] | yes |  |
| `runner.jobs` | object[] |  |  |
| `runner.timezone` | string |  |  |
| `runner.reported` | string | yes |  |
| `runner.jobsReported` | string |  |  |
| `changed` | boolean | yes |  |

**Example: Home server**

```sh
curl -sS -X POST "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/envs/default-workspace/runners/Home%20server" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"models":[{"id":"claudeAgent:claude-sonnet-5-5","label":"Claude · Sonnet 5.5","provider":"Claude","billing":"included"}]}'
```

```json
{
  "rev": 59,
  "runner": {
    "name": "Home server",
    "models": [
      {
        "id": "claudeAgent:claude-sonnet-5-5",
        "label": "Claude · Sonnet 5.5",
        "provider": "Claude",
        "billing": "included"
      }
    ],
    "jobs": [],
    "reported": "2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z"
  },
  "changed": true
}
```

**Example: With scheduled jobs**

```sh
curl -sS -X POST "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/envs/default-workspace/runners/Home%20server" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"models":[{"id":"claudeAgent:claude-sonnet-5-5","label":"Claude · Sonnet 5.5"}],"jobs":[{"id":"systemd:backup.timer","name":"Nightly backup","source":"systemd","group":"Home server","schedule":"Daily 22:30","cron":"30 22 * * *","timezone":"America/Phoenix","triggers":[{"kind":"calendar","expr":"*-*-* 22:30:00","text":"Daily 22:30"}],"origin":"machine","command":"restic backup /srv","ai":false,"enabled":true,"lastRun":"2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z","lastStatus":"ok","nextRun":"2026-10-30T22:30:00.000Z"}]}'
```

```json
{
  "rev": 60,
  "runner": {
    "name": "Home server",
    "models": [
      {
        "id": "claudeAgent:claude-sonnet-5-5",
        "label": "Claude · Sonnet 5.5",
        "provider": "Claude",
        "billing": "included"
      }
    ],
    "jobs": [
      {
        "id": "systemd:backup.timer",
        "name": "Nightly backup",
        "source": "systemd",
        "group": "Home server",
        "schedule": "Daily 22:30",
        "cron": "30 22 * * *",
        "timezone": "America/Phoenix",
        "triggers": [
          {
            "kind": "calendar",
            "expr": "*-*-* 22:30:00",
            "text": "Daily 22:30"
          }
        ],
        "origin": "machine",
        "command": "restic backup /srv",
        "ai": false,
        "enabled": true,
        "lastRun": "2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z",
        "lastStatus": "ok",
        "nextRun": "2026-10-30T22:30:00.000Z"
      }
    ],
    "reported": "2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z",
    "jobsReported": "2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z"
  },
  "changed": true
}
```

## Search

### `search`

Search an environment

`GET /api/v1/envs/{env}/search` · scope `read` · MCP tool `search`

Case-insensitive search over chart nodes (name, notes), projects, timeline items (title, notes), cards (#number, title, description), AgentFlow agents (name, role, purpose) and workflows (name, description). `types` narrows it (comma-separated in a query string).

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `env` | string | yes | Environment id (see envs.list). |
| `q` | string | yes |  |
| `types` | enum[] |  |  |
| `limit` | integer |  | Page size (1-200, default 50). |
| `cursor` | string |  | nextCursor from the previous page. |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | object[] | yes |  |
| `items[].type` | enum | yes | One of `node`, `project`, `item`, `card`, `agent`, `workflow`. |
| `items[].id` | string | yes |  |
| `items[].title` | string | yes |  |
| `items[].chart` | string |  |  |
| `items[].number` | integer |  |  |
| `nextCursor` | string | null | yes |  |
| `rev` | integer | yes | Workspace revision after (or at) this call. |

**Example: Sign-up**

```sh
curl -sS -X GET "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/envs/default-workspace/search?q=sign-up" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY"
```

```json
{
  "items": [
    {
      "type": "card",
      "id": "k1",
      "title": "Build sign-up form",
      "number": 12
    }
  ],
  "nextCursor": null,
  "rev": 42
}
```

## Sharing

### `shares.list`

List shares of an environment

`GET /api/v1/envs/{env}/shares` · scope `read` · MCP tool `shares_list`

Who you share this environment (or parts of it) with: each share's recipient, permission, scope in words and counts, plus the pending re-share requests on them (approve or deny with shares.requests.decide). Only the environment's owner can list them; anyone else gets 404.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `env` | string | yes | Environment id (see envs.list). |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `shares` | object[] | yes |  |
| `shares[].id` | string | null | yes | null in a preview of a share that does not exist yet. |
| `shares[].ownerEnv` | string | yes |  |
| `shares[].ownerEnvName` | string |  |  |
| `shares[].ownerEmail` | string | yes |  |
| `shares[].recipientEmail` | string | yes |  |
| `shares[].permission` | enum | yes | One of `view`, `comment`, `edit`. |
| `shares[].adds` | enum |  | What the recipient may add (edit shares only). One of `off`, `approve`, `direct`. |
| `shares[].scope` | object | yes |  |
| `shares[].name` | string |  |  |
| `shares[].createdAt` | string | yes |  |
| `shares[].createdBy` | string |  | Email of the owner who shared it. |
| `shares[].actor` | string | null |  | The API key (or MCP connector) that created it, by name; null when made in the app. Settings › Sharing shows it as "Created by". |
| `shares[].via` | string | null |  | The re-share request it was approved from, if any. |
| `shares[].revokedAt` | string | null | yes |  |
| `shares[].scopeLabel` | string | yes | What it holds, in words. |
| `shares[].summary` | union |  |  |
| `shares[].tip` | string | null |  | A note when the scope may not hold what people expect (e.g. mind map cards but no DevOps cards). |
| `requests` | object[] | yes |  |
| `requests[].id` | string | yes |  |
| `requests[].shareId` | string | yes |  |
| `requests[].ownerEmail` | string | yes |  |
| `requests[].requestedBy` | string | yes |  |
| `requests[].toEmail` | string | yes |  |
| `requests[].permission` | enum | yes | One of `view`, `comment`, `edit`. |
| `requests[].note` | string |  |  |
| `requests[].status` | enum | yes | One of `pending`, `approved`, `denied`. |
| `requests[].createdAt` | string | yes |  |
| `requests[].decidedAt` | string | null |  |  |
| `requests[].decidedBy` | string | null |  |  |
| `requests[].newShareId` | string | null |  |  |

### `shares.preview`

Preview what a share would show

`POST /api/v1/envs/{env}/shares/preview` · scope `read` · MCP tool `shares_preview`

Exactly what a recipient would see for a scope, before you share: chart cards, co-owner stubs (name only), projects, timeline items and DevOps cards, with counts and a tip when the scope may surprise people. Nothing is stored. Owner only.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `env` | string | yes | Environment id (see envs.list). |
| `scope` | object | yes | What to share. Names are matched like everywhere else (id first, then the name, ignoring case), against your own records. |
| `scope.kind` | enum | yes | environment (everything in it), project (a project with its timeline items and DevOps cards), label (the DevOps cards with a label), person (a chart card and everything connected below it, with their projects) or nodes (hand-picked chart cards, nothing below them). One of `environment`, `project`, `label`, `person`, `nodes`. |
| `scope.project` | string |  | For kind project: the project, id or name. |
| `scope.label` | string |  | For kind label: the DevOps label, id or name. |
| `scope.node` | string |  | For kind person: the chart card to start from (a person or any card), id or name. |
| `scope.nodes` | string[] |  | For kind nodes: the chart cards, ids or names. |
| `scope.chart` | string |  | Optional: only this chart's cards and lines (chart id or name, or "active"). |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `preview` | object | yes |  |
| `preview.nodes` | object[] | yes | Chart cards the recipient will see. |
| `preview.stubs` | object[] | yes | Co-owners shown by name only (read only). |
| `preview.projects` | object[] | yes |  |
| `preview.items` | object[] | yes |  |
| `preview.cards` | object[] | yes |  |
| `preview.summary` | object | yes |  |
| `preview.tip` | string | null | yes |  |
| `label` | string | yes | The scope in words, as Settings › Sharing shows it. |

### `shares.create`

Share part of an environment with someone

`POST /api/v1/envs/{env}/shares` · scope `write` · MCP tool `shares_create`

Gives another Flow user (by email) access to part of your environment: they see it as linked records they can add to their own environments, and edit or comment when the permission allows. Two steps, because this grants a person access to data: without confirm: true it only answers with the preview (what they would see) and stores nothing (200, created false). Show that preview to your user and ask them before you call again with confirm: true, which creates the share (201). Sharing the same scope with the same person again changes the permission instead (existing true). Only the environment's owner can share it; records shared with you (ids sh.…) cannot be shared on: ask their owner with shares.requests.create. Needs a key with write access to this environment. The share records the key's name, shown in Settings › Sharing as "Created by".

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `env` | string | yes | Environment id (see envs.list). |
| `recipientEmail` | string | yes | Who to share with: their email (the account they sign in to Flow with). |
| `scope` | object | yes | What to share. Names are matched like everywhere else (id first, then the name, ignoring case), against your own records. |
| `scope.kind` | enum | yes | environment (everything in it), project (a project with its timeline items and DevOps cards), label (the DevOps cards with a label), person (a chart card and everything connected below it, with their projects) or nodes (hand-picked chart cards, nothing below them). One of `environment`, `project`, `label`, `person`, `nodes`. |
| `scope.project` | string |  | For kind project: the project, id or name. |
| `scope.label` | string |  | For kind label: the DevOps label, id or name. |
| `scope.node` | string |  | For kind person: the chart card to start from (a person or any card), id or name. |
| `scope.nodes` | string[] |  | For kind nodes: the chart cards, ids or names. |
| `scope.chart` | string |  | Optional: only this chart's cards and lines (chart id or name, or "active"). |
| `permission` | enum |  | view (read only), comment (read and comment) or edit (change the shared fields and comment). One of `view`, `comment`, `edit`. |
| `adds` | enum |  | Edit shares only: what the recipient may add to your environment inside the share (cards, timeline items, projects, mind map cards). off (the default), approve (each addition waits for you: proposals.list, proposals.approve, proposals.deny) or direct (added at once). View and comment shares are always off. One of `off`, `approve`, `direct`. |
| `name` | string |  | Optional label for the share. |
| `confirm` | boolean |  | false (the default): preview only, nothing is shared. true: create the share. Only send true after your user has seen the preview and agreed. |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `created` | boolean | yes | True when this call created a new share. |
| `existing` | boolean | yes | The same scope is already shared with this person (its permission is changed on confirm). |
| `confirmed` | boolean | yes | Whether confirm was true. false: nothing was stored. |
| `share` | object | yes |  |
| `share.id` | string | null | yes | null in a preview of a share that does not exist yet. |
| `share.ownerEnv` | string | yes |  |
| `share.ownerEnvName` | string |  |  |
| `share.ownerEmail` | string | yes |  |
| `share.recipientEmail` | string | yes |  |
| `share.permission` | enum | yes | One of `view`, `comment`, `edit`. |
| `share.adds` | enum |  | What the recipient may add (edit shares only). One of `off`, `approve`, `direct`. |
| `share.scope` | object | yes |  |
| `share.name` | string |  |  |
| `share.createdAt` | string | yes |  |
| `share.createdBy` | string |  | Email of the owner who shared it. |
| `share.actor` | string | null |  | The API key (or MCP connector) that created it, by name; null when made in the app. Settings › Sharing shows it as "Created by". |
| `share.via` | string | null |  | The re-share request it was approved from, if any. |
| `share.revokedAt` | string | null | yes |  |
| `share.scopeLabel` | string | yes | What it holds, in words. |
| `share.summary` | union |  |  |
| `share.tip` | string | null |  | A note when the scope may not hold what people expect (e.g. mind map cards but no DevOps cards). |
| `preview` | object | yes |  |
| `preview.nodes` | object[] | yes | Chart cards the recipient will see. |
| `preview.stubs` | object[] | yes | Co-owners shown by name only (read only). |
| `preview.projects` | object[] | yes |  |
| `preview.items` | object[] | yes |  |
| `preview.cards` | object[] | yes |  |
| `preview.summary` | object | yes |  |
| `preview.tip` | string | null | yes |  |
| `label` | string | yes |  |

### `shares.update`

Change a share's permission

`PATCH /api/v1/shares/{share}` · scope `write` · MCP tool `shares_update`

Set what the recipient may do: permission view, comment or edit, and for edit shares adds (whether they may add records). Send either or both. Lowering an edit share to view or comment turns additions off. Owner only (anyone else gets 404); a revoked share gets 409.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `share` | string | yes | Share id (from shares.list or shares.incoming). |
| `permission` | enum |  | view (read only), comment (read and comment) or edit (change the shared fields and comment). One of `view`, `comment`, `edit`. |
| `adds` | enum |  | Edit shares only: what the recipient may add to your environment inside the share (cards, timeline items, projects, mind map cards). off (the default), approve (each addition waits for you: proposals.list, proposals.approve, proposals.deny) or direct (added at once). View and comment shares are always off. One of `off`, `approve`, `direct`. |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `share` | object | yes |  |
| `share.id` | string | null | yes | null in a preview of a share that does not exist yet. |
| `share.ownerEnv` | string | yes |  |
| `share.ownerEnvName` | string |  |  |
| `share.ownerEmail` | string | yes |  |
| `share.recipientEmail` | string | yes |  |
| `share.permission` | enum | yes | One of `view`, `comment`, `edit`. |
| `share.adds` | enum |  | What the recipient may add (edit shares only). One of `off`, `approve`, `direct`. |
| `share.scope` | object | yes |  |
| `share.name` | string |  |  |
| `share.createdAt` | string | yes |  |
| `share.createdBy` | string |  | Email of the owner who shared it. |
| `share.actor` | string | null |  | The API key (or MCP connector) that created it, by name; null when made in the app. Settings › Sharing shows it as "Created by". |
| `share.via` | string | null |  | The re-share request it was approved from, if any. |
| `share.revokedAt` | string | null | yes |  |
| `share.scopeLabel` | string | yes | What it holds, in words. |
| `share.summary` | union |  |  |
| `share.tip` | string | null |  | A note when the scope may not hold what people expect (e.g. mind map cards but no DevOps cards). |

### `shares.revoke`

Revoke a share

`DELETE /api/v1/shares/{share}` · scope `write` · MCP tool `shares_revoke`

Stop sharing: the linked records leave every environment of the recipient's on their next read (their own records stay). The share and its history are kept, marked revoked. Owner only.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `share` | string | yes | Share id (from shares.list or shares.incoming). |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `share` | object | yes |  |
| `share.id` | string | null | yes | null in a preview of a share that does not exist yet. |
| `share.ownerEnv` | string | yes |  |
| `share.ownerEnvName` | string |  |  |
| `share.ownerEmail` | string | yes |  |
| `share.recipientEmail` | string | yes |  |
| `share.permission` | enum | yes | One of `view`, `comment`, `edit`. |
| `share.adds` | enum |  | What the recipient may add (edit shares only). One of `off`, `approve`, `direct`. |
| `share.scope` | object | yes |  |
| `share.name` | string |  |  |
| `share.createdAt` | string | yes |  |
| `share.createdBy` | string |  | Email of the owner who shared it. |
| `share.actor` | string | null |  | The API key (or MCP connector) that created it, by name; null when made in the app. Settings › Sharing shows it as "Created by". |
| `share.via` | string | null |  | The re-share request it was approved from, if any. |
| `share.revokedAt` | string | null | yes |  |
| `share.scopeLabel` | string | yes | What it holds, in words. |
| `share.summary` | union |  |  |
| `share.tip` | string | null |  | A note when the scope may not hold what people expect (e.g. mind map cards but no DevOps cards). |
| `revoked` | boolean | yes |  |

### `shares.requests.create`

Ask the owner to share it on

`POST /api/v1/shares/{share}/requests` · scope `write` · MCP tool `shares_requests_create`

You cannot share what is shared with you, but you can ask its owner to share the same records with someone else. The permission defaults to yours and cannot be more than yours. The owner approves (maybe at a lower permission) or denies it in Settings › Sharing or with shares.requests.decide.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `share` | string | yes | Share id (from shares.list or shares.incoming). |
| `toEmail` | string | yes | Who it should be shared with. |
| `permission` | enum |  | view (read only), comment (read and comment) or edit (change the shared fields and comment). One of `view`, `comment`, `edit`. |
| `note` | string |  | A note for the owner. |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `request` | object | yes |  |
| `request.id` | string | yes |  |
| `request.shareId` | string | yes |  |
| `request.ownerEmail` | string | yes |  |
| `request.requestedBy` | string | yes |  |
| `request.toEmail` | string | yes |  |
| `request.permission` | enum | yes | One of `view`, `comment`, `edit`. |
| `request.note` | string |  |  |
| `request.status` | enum | yes | One of `pending`, `approved`, `denied`. |
| `request.createdAt` | string | yes |  |
| `request.decidedAt` | string | null |  |  |
| `request.decidedBy` | string | null |  |  |
| `request.newShareId` | string | null |  |  |

**Example: Ask to share with Kim**

```sh
curl -sS -X POST "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/shares/6f1c2a4e-0b7d-4c55-9a3e-2d8f1b0c9e11/requests" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"toEmail":"kim@example.com","permission":"view","note":"Kim helps with the launch"}'
```

### `shares.requests.decide`

Approve or deny a re-share request

`POST /api/v1/share-requests/{request}` · scope `write` · MCP tool `shares_requests_decide`

The owner's answer to a request from shares.requests.list. approve: true creates a new share of the same scope with the person asked for, at the requested permission or the lower one you pass; false denies it. Like shares.create, approving grants a person access: show the request to your user first. A request already decided gets 409.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `request` | string | yes | Request id. |
| `approve` | boolean | yes |  |
| `permission` | enum |  | Optional: approve at this permission (not more than requested). One of `view`, `comment`, `edit`. |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `request` | object | yes |  |
| `request.id` | string | yes |  |
| `request.shareId` | string | yes |  |
| `request.ownerEmail` | string | yes |  |
| `request.requestedBy` | string | yes |  |
| `request.toEmail` | string | yes |  |
| `request.permission` | enum | yes | One of `view`, `comment`, `edit`. |
| `request.note` | string |  |  |
| `request.status` | enum | yes | One of `pending`, `approved`, `denied`. |
| `request.createdAt` | string | yes |  |
| `request.decidedAt` | string | null |  |  |
| `request.decidedBy` | string | null |  |  |
| `request.newShareId` | string | null |  |  |
| `share` | union | yes | The new share when approved; null when denied. |

```sh
curl -sS -X POST "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/share-requests/0c7e9a52-3b1d-4f0e-8a6c-5d2b9e4f1a77" \
```

### `proposals.list`

List share additions

`GET /api/v1/envs/{env}/proposals` · scope `read` · MCP tool `proposals_list`

Records that recipients of this environment's edit shares added while their share needs your approval (role owner), and the ones you added from this environment to someone else's share (role proposer). status: pending (the default), approved, denied, withdrawn, or applied (added at once by a share that allows it). preview says what each one adds. Decide with proposals.approve or proposals.deny; set what a share allows in the app (Settings › Sharing).

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `env` | string | yes | Environment id (see envs.list). |
| `status` | enum |  | One of `pending`, `approved`, `denied`, `applied`, `withdrawn`. |
| `limit` | integer |  | Page size (1-200, default 50). |
| `cursor` | string |  | nextCursor from the previous page. |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | object[] | yes |  |
| `items[].id` | string | yes |  |
| `items[].shareId` | string | yes |  |
| `items[].env` | string | yes | The environment of the share's owner. |
| `items[].proposedBy` | string | yes | Who added them (the share's recipient). |
| `items[].status` | enum | yes | One of `pending`, `approved`, `denied`, `applied`, `withdrawn`. |
| `items[].role` | enum |  | owner: yours to approve or deny; proposer: you added it to someone else's share. One of `owner`, `proposer`. |
| `items[].createdAt` | string | yes |  |
| `items[].updatedAt` | string |  |  |
| `items[].decidedAt` | string | null |  |  |
| `items[].decidedBy` | string | null |  |  |
| `items[].preview` | object[] | yes |  |
| `items[].records` | object |  | The records as they would land in the owner's data, by kind (node, edge, project, item, card). Owner only. |
| `nextCursor` | string | null | yes |  |
| `rev` | integer | yes | Workspace revision after (or at) this call. |

### `proposals.approve`

Approve a share addition

`POST /api/v1/envs/{env}/proposals/{proposal}/approve` · scope `write` · MCP tool `proposals_approve`

Add a pending proposal's records to this environment, owned by you (cards get your next numbers). The recipient then sees them as ordinary shared records. Only the environment's owner can; a decided one is refused with 409 proposal_decided, and one that no longer fits its share (what it was added to is gone or no longer shared) with 409 proposal_out_of_scope.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |

| `env` | string | yes | Environment id (see envs.list). |
| `proposal` | string | yes | Proposal id (proposals.list). |

| `proposal.shareId` | string | yes |  |
| `proposal.env` | string | yes | The environment of the share's owner. |
| `proposal.proposedBy` | string | yes | Who added them (the share's recipient). |
| `proposal.status` | enum | yes | One of `pending`, `approved`, `denied`, `applied`, `withdrawn`. |
| `proposal.role` | enum |  | owner: yours to approve or deny; proposer: you added it to someone else's share. One of `owner`, `proposer`. |
| `proposal.createdAt` | string | yes |  |
| `proposal.updatedAt` | string |  |  |
| `proposal.decidedAt` | string | null |  |  |
| `proposal.decidedBy` | string | null |  |  |
| `proposal.preview` | object[] | yes |  |
| `proposal.records` | object |  | The records as they would land in the owner's data, by kind (node, edge, project, item, card). Owner only. |

### `proposals.deny`

`POST /api/v1/envs/{env}/proposals/{proposal}/deny` · scope `write` · MCP tool `proposals_deny`

Turn down a pending proposal. Nothing is added; the recipient's pending copy disappears and they are told it was denied. A decided one is refused with 409 proposal_decided.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `env` | string | yes | Environment id (see envs.list). |
| `proposal` | string | yes | Proposal id (proposals.list). |

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `proposal` | object | yes |  |
| `proposal.id` | string | yes |  |
| `proposal.shareId` | string | yes |  |
| `proposal.env` | string | yes | The environment of the share's owner. |
| `proposal.proposedBy` | string | yes | Who added them (the share's recipient). |
| `proposal.status` | enum | yes | One of `pending`, `approved`, `denied`, `applied`, `withdrawn`. |
| `proposal.role` | enum |  | owner: yours to approve or deny; proposer: you added it to someone else's share. One of `owner`, `proposer`. |
| `proposal.createdAt` | string | yes |  |
| `proposal.updatedAt` | string |  |  |
| `proposal.decidedAt` | string | null |  |  |
| `proposal.decidedBy` | string | null |  |  |
| `proposal.preview` | object[] | yes |  |
| `proposal.records` | object |  | The records as they would land in the owner's data, by kind (node, edge, project, item, card). Owner only. |
