## 3D office

### `office.agents.report`

Report your live coding agents

`PUT /api/v1/office/agents` · scope `write` · MCP tool `office_agents_report`

A reporter on your machine (flow office bridge, or any integration) sends every coding agent running there, every few seconds. Agents belong to you (the key's owner) and show at your desk in the 3D office of every environment you are a member of, or, working on an AgentFlow agent's card (agentflow, or a title such as "[Flow] Builder: #12 …"), at that agent's desk in the common area. Each source replaces only its own set, and a source that has not reported for 90 seconds is gone. Others see an agent's details only when its repo belongs to a project they can see (projects.update repos); otherwise just its mascot and status, as "Private project". An optional usage object ({tokens, costUsd} for the reporter’s local day) contributes to that person's room meter when the viewer can see the agent. The office bridge sends measured usage and estimates cost at API list prices. Up to 200 agents and 20 children each are kept, and long strings are cut. The answer holds the actions from the office that this source has not been sent yet (also served by office.actions.wait): Allow / Deny answers, and messages and stops for agents that list them in can.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `source` | string | yes | The reporter, e.g. "bridge:laptop". Each source replaces only its own agents. |
| `at` | string |  | When the reporter read its agents (ISO time). |
| `agents` | any[] | yes |  |
| `threads` | any |  | Your recent threads on this source, as your T3 sidebar shows them, for you only: never sent to anyone else. Send it when it changes (and now and then); a report without it keeps the last one, null clears it. |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `actions` | object[] | yes |  |
| `actions[].id` | string | yes |  |
| `actions[].agentId` | string | yes |  |
| `actions[].source` | string |  |  |
| `actions[].kind` | enum | yes | answer: Allow / Deny (requestId, decision); message: send text as a new user turn (to a live agent, or to any thread in your threads index, idle ones too); stop: interrupt its running turn; model: switch its next turn to text, a provider:model id (the Chief of Staff picker); history: send back a page of the thread's conversation as the result's data. Treat a missing kind as answer. One of `answer`, `message`, `stop`, `model`, `history`. |
| `actions[].requestId` | string |  | answer only. |
| `actions[].decision` | enum |  | answer only. One of `allow`, `deny`. |
| `actions[].text` | string |  | message: what its owner wrote. model: provider:model, e.g. cursor_personal:grok-4.7. |
| `actions[].before` | string |  | history only: the cursor from the last page (its before); missing for the newest page. |
| `actions[].at` | string | yes |  |
| `actions[].result` | object |  |  |
| `accepted` | integer |  | How many agents were kept. |

**Example: One agent waiting on a prompt**

```sh
curl -sS -X PUT "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/office/agents" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"source":"bridge:laptop","at":"2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z","agents":[{"id":"laptop:t3:thread-abc","title":"Fix login bug","vendor":"claude","model":"Opus 5.5","status":"waiting","activity":"Waiting for approval","activityKind":"test","host":"laptop","hostLabel":"laptop · T3","repo":{"name":"flow","remote":"https://github.com/acme/flow.git"},"children":[],"pending":{"requestId":"req-1","kind":"approval","summary":"Run: npm test","can":["allow","deny"]},"agentflow":{"agent":"Builder","card":12},"can":["message","stop"],"transcript":[{"role":"user","text":"Fix the login redirect loop.","at":"2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z"},{"role":"assistant","text":"The callback keeps ?next=/login. Running the tests next.","at":"2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z"},{"role":"tool","text":"Run: npm test","at":"2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z"}]}]}'
```

```json
{
  "actions": [],
  "accepted": 1
}
```

### `office.agents.list`

List your reported agents

`GET /api/v1/office/agents` · scope `read` · MCP tool `office_agents_list`

Your live agents as Flow holds them (every source that reported in the last 90 seconds), in full, and the sources.

**Input**: see schema

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `agents` | object[] | yes |  |
| `agents[].id` | string | yes | Stable and unique within the source, e.g. "laptop:t3:thread-abc". |
| `agents[].title` | string |  | What it is working on (up to 200 characters). |
| `agents[].vendor` | string |  | Which mascot it gets: claude, codex, gemini, deepseek, grok, meta or other (other: picked from the model when it names one). |
| `agents[].model` | string |  | Display name, e.g. "Opus 5.5". |
| `agents[].status` | string |  | running (working), waiting (on its person: a permission prompt or a question) or idle. |
| `agents[].activity` | string |  | What it is doing right now, e.g. "Running tests" or "Edit lib/auth.mjs". |
| `agents[].activityKind` | string |  | What kind of work it is doing, for its animation in the office: edit (changing files), read, search, run (shell commands), test, think, web or idle. Optional: when missing or unknown, Flow infers it from activity (a tool name such as Edit, Read, Grep, Bash or WebFetch, or words such as "Running tests"); an idle agent is always idle. Shown for private agents too. One of `edit`, `read`, `search`, `run`, `test`, `think`, `web`, `idle`. |
| `agents[].host` | string |  | The machine, e.g. "laptop". |
| `agents[].hostLabel` | string |  | How to show where it runs, e.g. "laptop · T3". |
| `agents[].repo` | object | null |  | The repository it works in: matched against projects' repos to decide who may see the details. |
| `agents[].children` | object[] |  | Its subagents (up to 20 kept). |
| `agents[].pending` | object | null |  | What it waits on (only kept while status is waiting). |
| `agents[].agentflow` | object | null |  | The AgentFlow agent and card it works on, when the reporter knows: it then sits at that agent's desk in the office's common area. Resolved in each environment against its own agents and cards (elsewhere it keeps its own desk). Without it, Flow reads the title: "[Flow] <Agent>: #<n> …" (the agent runner's threads), or "#<n>" for a card delegated to exactly one agent. |
| `agents[].modelId` | string |  | The model its next turn uses, provider:model (cursor_personal:grok-4.7). The Chief of Staff reports it so the office picker can show the current choice. Its owner only. |
| `agents[].can` | string[] |  | What its owner may do from the office besides Allow / Deny: "message" (send it a message as a new user turn), "stop" (interrupt its running turn), "model" (switch its next turn to another model) and "history" (send back a page of its conversation, office.actions.wait kind history). Only list what this reporter can carry out; [] or none when it can only be steered where it runs. |
| `agents[].live` | object | null |  | What it is doing this moment, for its owner only (never anyone else, whatever they can see; dropped while idle): its latest reasoning snippet, tool call or partial reply, and its last steps. Masked again on the server. Send it with each report, and in between with office.live.report as it changes. |
| `agents[].transcript` | object[] |  | The latest lines of its conversation (the last 12 are kept, each cut to 400 characters), shown only to its owner: never to anyone else, whatever they can see. Mask secrets before sending; Flow masks tokens, keys, Authorization headers and .env-looking lines again. |
| `agents[].role` | string |  | conductor: this agent is its owner's Chief of Staff, a long-lived thread that takes their messages from the office, routes work to AgentFlow agents and answers questions. The office draws it as their companion. Always private to everyone but its owner (others see only that it is one, and its status), whatever its repo. Report at most one per person; list "message" in can. One of `conductor`. |
| `agents[].reply` | object | null |  | A conductor's latest reply, for its owner only (like transcript; masked again on the server): what the office shows in its bubble and log. |
| `agents[].usage` | object | null |  | Optional model use for today, as the reporter measured it. Omit the object when you do not measure use: the office meter then shows a dash. The office bridge does not send this yet. Someone who cannot see the agent does not receive it (they still see running or waiting). |
| `sources` | object[] | yes |  |
| `sources[].source` | string | yes |  |
| `sources[].at` | string | yes |  |
| `sources[].agents` | integer | yes |  |
| `threads` | object[] | yes | Each source's thread index (office.agents.report threads), with its source. |
| `threads[].items` | object[] |  | Up to 150, newest first. |
| `threads[].counts` | object |  | How many threads are snoozed and settled in all (the index may list only recent ones). |
| `threads[].can` | string[] |  | What the office may ask of any thread in it: message (a new user turn, idle threads too) and history (a page of its conversation). |
| `threads[].at` | string |  |  |

**Example: Yours**

```sh
curl -sS -X GET "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/office/agents" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY"
```

```json
{
  "agents": [
    {
      "id": "laptop:t3:thread-abc",
      "title": "Fix login bug",
      "vendor": "claude",
      "model": "Opus 5.5",
      "status": "waiting",
      "activity": "Waiting for approval",
      "activityKind": "test",
      "host": "laptop",
      "hostLabel": "laptop · T3",
      "repo": {
        "name": "flow",
        "remote": "https://github.com/acme/flow.git"
      },
      "children": [],
      "pending": {
        "requestId": "req-1",
        "kind": "approval",
        "summary": "Run: npm test",
        "can": [
          "allow",
          "deny"
        ]
      },
      "agentflow": {
        "agent": "Builder",
        "card": 12
      },
      "can": [
        "message",
        "stop"
      ],
      "transcript": [
        {
          "role": "user",
          "text": "Fix the login redirect loop.",
          "at": "2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z"
        },
        {
          "role": "assistant",
          "text": "The callback keeps ?next=/login. Running the tests next.",
          "at": "2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z"
        },
        {
          "role": "tool",
          "text": "Run: npm test",
          "at": "2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z"
        }
      ],
      "source": "bridge:laptop"
    }
  ],
  "sources": [
    {
      "source": "bridge:laptop",
      "at": "2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z",
      "agents": 1
    }
  ],
  "threads": []
}
```

### `office.live.report`

Stream what your agents are doing

`POST /api/v1/office/live` · scope `write` · MCP tool `office_live_report`

Between reports, as it changes: each agent's live field (its latest reasoning, tool call or partial reply, and its last steps) for agents in this source's current report. Only you, their owner, ever see it, in your own office. live null clears it; idle agents and unknown ids are skipped. Up to 30 in a burst, then 8 a second per source: debounce on your side (about 150 ms). Kept in memory only: the next office.agents.report carries it too.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `source` | string | yes | The reporter, e.g. "bridge:laptop". Each source replaces only its own agents. |
| `agents` | object[] | yes |  |
| `agents[].id` | string |  |  |
| `agents[].live` | any |  | What it is doing this moment, for its owner only (never anyone else, whatever they can see; dropped while idle): its latest reasoning snippet, tool call or partial reply, and its last steps. Masked again on the server. Send it with each report, and in between with office.live.report as it changes. |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `accepted` | integer | yes | How many agents' live fields changed. |

**Example: Thinking**

```sh
curl -sS -X POST "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/office/live" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"source":"bridge:laptop","agents":[{"id":"laptop:t3:thread-abc","live":{"phase":"tool","text":"Run: npm test","steps":[{"kind":"thinking","text":"Checking the redirect","at":"2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z"},{"kind":"tool","text":"Run: npm test","at":"2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z"}]}}]}'
```

```json
{
  "accepted": 1
}
```

### `office.actions.wait`

Wait for answers to your agents' prompts

`GET /api/v1/office/actions` · scope `write` · MCP tool `office_actions_wait`

Long-poll for the actions taken in the 3D office on this source's agents by their owner: returns as soon as one is queued, or an empty list after wait seconds (0 to 30; 0 answers at once). kind answer is Allow / Deny on pending.requestId (a missing kind is answer); message is text to send as a new user turn; stop interrupts its running turn; model switches its next turn to text (provider:model). Each only for agents whose can lists that kind. Each action is delivered once (here or in the office.agents.report answer). Check the agent is still the same and still yours, carry it out, then send the result with office.actions.result.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `source` | string | yes | The reporter, e.g. "bridge:laptop". Each source replaces only its own agents. |
| `wait` | integer |  | Seconds to wait for an answer (0-30). |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `actions` | object[] | yes |  |
| `actions[].id` | string | yes |  |
| `actions[].agentId` | string | yes |  |
| `actions[].source` | string |  |  |
| `actions[].kind` | enum | yes | answer: Allow / Deny (requestId, decision); message: send text as a new user turn (to a live agent, or to any thread in your threads index, idle ones too); stop: interrupt its running turn; model: switch its next turn to text, a provider:model id (the Chief of Staff picker); history: send back a page of the thread's conversation as the result's data. Treat a missing kind as answer. One of `answer`, `message`, `stop`, `model`, `history`. |
| `actions[].requestId` | string |  | answer only. |
| `actions[].decision` | enum |  | answer only. One of `allow`, `deny`. |
| `actions[].text` | string |  | message: what its owner wrote. model: provider:model, e.g. cursor_personal:grok-4.7. |
| `actions[].before` | string |  | history only: the cursor from the last page (its before); missing for the newest page. |
| `actions[].at` | string | yes |  |
| `actions[].result` | object |  |  |

**Example: An answer**

```sh
curl -sS -X GET "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/office/actions?source=bridge%3Alaptop&wait=25" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY"
```

```json
{
  "actions": [
    {
      "id": "act_1",
      "agentId": "laptop:t3:thread-abc",
      "source": "bridge:laptop",
      "kind": "answer",
      "requestId": "req-1",
      "decision": "allow",
      "at": "2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z"
    }
  ]
}
```

**Example: A message and a stop**

```sh
curl -sS -X GET "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/office/actions?source=bridge%3Alaptop&wait=25" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY"
```

```json
{
  "actions": [
    {
      "id": "act_2",
      "agentId": "laptop:t3:thread-abc",
      "source": "bridge:laptop",
      "kind": "message",
      "text": "Also add a test for it.",
      "at": "2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z"
    },
    {
      "id": "act_3",
      "agentId": "laptop:t3:thread-abc",
      "source": "bridge:laptop",
      "kind": "stop",
      "at": "2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z"
    }
  ]
}
```

### `office.actions.result`

Say how an answer went

`POST /api/v1/office/actions/{id}` · scope `write` · MCP tool `office_actions_result`

The reporter carried out (or could not carry out) an action from office.actions.wait: the agent's owner sees the message in the office right away. Keep it short, and never echo a message's text.

**Input**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string | yes | The action id (act_…). |
| `ok` | boolean | yes |  |
| `message` | string |  | e.g. "Approved in T3". |
| `data` | object | null |  | history only: the page, {items, before, more}, oldest first. Each item: id (stable within the thread, up to 80 characters, so pages merge), role (user, assistant, reasoning or tool), text (up to 4000 characters), title (a tool call or reasoning summary, up to 200), detail (a tool's short result, up to 600), status, at, turn. Up to 60 items and 64 KB; masked again. before: the cursor for the page before this one; more: there is one. Delivered to the owner's open office and never stored. |

**Output**

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `action` | object | yes |  |
| `action.id` | string | yes |  |
| `action.agentId` | string | yes |  |
| `action.source` | string |  |  |
| `action.kind` | enum | yes | answer: Allow / Deny (requestId, decision); message: send text as a new user turn (to a live agent, or to any thread in your threads index, idle ones too); stop: interrupt its running turn; model: switch its next turn to text, a provider:model id (the Chief of Staff picker); history: send back a page of the thread's conversation as the result's data. Treat a missing kind as answer. One of `answer`, `message`, `stop`, `model`, `history`. |
| `action.requestId` | string |  | answer only. |
| `action.decision` | enum |  | answer only. One of `allow`, `deny`. |
| `action.text` | string |  | message: what its owner wrote. model: provider:model, e.g. cursor_personal:grok-4.7. |
| `action.before` | string |  | history only: the cursor from the last page (its before); missing for the newest page. |
| `action.at` | string | yes |  |
| `action.result` | object |  |  |

**Example: Done**

```sh
curl -sS -X POST "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/office/actions/act_1" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"ok":true,"message":"Approved in T3"}'
```

```json
{
  "action": {
    "id": "act_1",
    "agentId": "laptop:t3:thread-abc",
    "source": "bridge:laptop",
    "kind": "answer",
    "requestId": "req-1",
    "decision": "allow",
    "at": "2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z",
    "result": {
      "ok": true,
      "message": "Approved in T3",
      "at": "2026-10-29T17:00:00.000Z"
    }
  }
}
```
